decisions.reason: The burner component supports the core gas radiant heater business and its installed service base, so it costs little to keep and remains useful.
The electric infrared panel line is a flagship that fits the market's shift toward electrified, lower-carbon heating.
The halogen heater serves niche spot and outdoor heating needs at low cost; it is less central, but no clear trigger for dropping it has appeared.
The industrial electric hall heater line is close to the core hall-heating business and meets growing demand for electric alternatives.
The hydrogen-capable dark infrared series is a strategic flagship with a documented real-world pilot and matches the firm's hydrogen-ready direction.
